reviews.text: Caring, organised and professional.   I trust them to take care of my little cat and provide me with good advice and make sure that she gets all her medications.  My cat is never stressed to visit them.  Been coming here for 15 years
An absolutely  wonderful service. Friendly, helpful and professional.

I have been going to West Side vets for around 26 years now, todays visit was for the second vaccination of my new puppy. The Vets and team at Westside are fantastic, caring and very knowledgeable. I recommend them wholeheartedly.
Great people lovely service !
The nurse cares for Tally my cat in a loving and gentle way and gave good advice

Concerningly terrible, so much so that we have had to report them to RVCS.  Please don’t take your animal here, they are not in good hands.

Most recently and the reason for this review is they had test results for our dog for several days confirming a cancerous tumor, and not only didn’t phone us immediately, but refused to provide the results via phone because they were “too busy” and refused to email them so we can take them to another vet.  We had to register him at another vet to have his files sent over.  Magically once the new vet requested his files a vet from Westside called.  5 days after results were received.  Appalling.

Aside from the recent distressing experience, very inconsistent level of care (with the exception of Padrich) and very unprofessional operation in general. They’re not a small mom and pop as they look, they’re owned by a large PE group of clinics, very transactional.

Interesting that the clinic commented on this review to “call to discuss” - my husband did in fact speak to them and the director had literally no words to their negligence for the delayed callback, but also said the vet who was dismissive the first visit was “her friend” so she doesn’t think our experience was accurate.  Zero professionalism or accountability.

Hopefully the clinic is investigated now that we’ve reported.

Padraig and the team were so helpful with us and our 2 nervous rescue cats, Flo & Scout for their annual checkups and booster vaccinations. He literally couldn't have done more to be helpful. Special mention to Lottie too who called me on the morning of the appointments when I didn't think I was going to get Flo in the carrier.

I should also add how helpful Padraig has been recently helping me with advice for preventative flea treatments too. He always goes above and beyond.

A great vets for those in the clapham area.
They've taken great care of my cat over the years.

All the staff are friendly and professional. I get excellent advice and, most important… my dog loves visiting and always rushes into the surgery. She is always greeted with kindness and treats! I would definitely recommend this vet.

Customers for ten years. We have good vets here over that time but Padraig is 10/10 for kindness, thoroughness and really taking good care. You feel in great hands. Shame about the pricing but that is London.
I have been bringing my dogs to Westside for years. I have always found them to be friendly, helpful and knowledgeable whether for regular health care or dealing with more serious issues.

Hi Andrew,  
Thank you for the great review. We really appreciate it.  
All the best,  
Westside Veterinary Clinic
I could not recommend Westside Vets and especially the truly wonderful, professional and caring Padraig.

Very caring and welcoming .
Lovely and clean reception area. The vet him self is very attentive and listens to your worries and concerns.
Very happy with my vets I have used for years.
A great vet with really friendly staff! Our whippet loves it too - always tries to go in to see her pals at Westside Vet, even when they are closed!
Padraig the vet was charming, thorough, professional and explained concisely. He was incredibly kind to my elderly dog! All was good until I paid the bill! 😳 …
This is a fantastic vet practice. The vets are always so gentle with our rehomed cat. We trust them implicitly. The reception staff are always so friendly and helpful too. Highly recommend!

Would not recommend this vet clinic - if in the past they managed very well my first dog I faced poor assessment and poor management this time  of my 4 month old puppy who suffered from a swallowed and infected neck. He ended up in emergency on Saturday and was referred on Sunday to an even bigger hospital as he needed CT scan
10/10 All staff members we have met so far are so lovely and very helpful. Never feel rushed in appointments. Very informative and clinic is very clean.
Lovely and friendly local vet. Very good at letting you know when you need worming and parasite tabs as well as reminding you of the next vaccination.
